mapper.select: SELECT uuid, email, code, scene, used, expire_time, create_user_id, update_user_id, create_time, update_time FROM sys_mail_code WHERE email = #{email} AND scene = #{scene} AND used = 0 AND expire_time > #{now} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_mail_code SET used = 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE uuid = #{uuid} AND used = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_mail_code (uuid, email, code, scene, used, expire_time, create_user_id, update_user_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{uuid}, #{email}, #{code}, #{scene}, #{used}, #{expireTime}, #{createUserId}, #{updateUserId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
